section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of positive affect using the 10-item General Positive Affect scale from the PANAS-X (Watson & Clark, 1994; Polish translation by Fajkowska & Marszał-Wisniewska, 2009). Respondents rated their feelings over the past week on a 5-point scale, with scores averaged to reflect positive affect intensity. The Polish version demonstrated adequate validity and reliability, with Cronbach's alpha of .87 in this study.
